title: Tattooist and tattoo master licences
summary: This page provides information and links for applying for or renewing tattooist and tattoo master licences in NSW.

internal_links.text: Apply for a tattoo master licence

faqs.q: How do I apply for a tattooist licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a tattooist licence using this link: https://www.service.nsw.gov.au/transaction/apply-for-a-tattooist-licence

faqs.q: How do I renew a tattooist licence?
faqs.a: You can renew your tattooist licence using this link: https://www.service.nsw.gov.au/transaction/renew-a-tattooist-licence

faqs.q: How do I apply for a tattoo master licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a tattoo master licence using this link: https://www.service.nsw.gov.au/transaction/apply-for-a-tattoo-master-licence

faqs.q: How do I renew a tattoo master licence?
faqs.a: You can renew your tattoo master licence using this link: https://www.service.nsw.gov.au/transaction/renew-a-tattoo-master-licence
